component.name: Super Media Player
component.summary: Play videos, music, streams and discs

description.p: A fast media player that plays almost anything: files, folders, internet radio, podcasts, network shares, YouTube and similar sites, audio CDs, DVDs with their menus, and Blu-rays. It can also send what you play to a TV.

ul.li: Media library with albums, artists, series and Continue watching
Audio CDs with song names and covers, ripped to exact FLAC files
Seek-bar previews, subtitles from speech, skipping intros
Equalizer, gapless and bit-perfect playback, MilkDrop visuals
Skins, a compact view and a command palette
